I am Associate Professor (Maître de Conférences) at Institut Agro Dijon and 
INRAE in the lab [UMR Agroécologie](https://umr-agroecologie.dijon.hub.inrae.fr).

<!--J'étais jusqu'à fin décembre 2024 ATER à l'[INSA de Lyon](http://www.insa-lyon.fr/), rattaché à l'[Institut Camille Jordan](http://math.univ-lyon1.fr) (recherche) et au département de génie électrique (enseignement).-->
I did my phD at [ÉNS de Lyon](https://www.umpa.ens-lyon.fr) under the supervision of [Grégory Miermont](https://perso.ens-lyon.fr/gregory.miermont/) and [Emmanuel Jacob](https://perso.ens-lyon.fr/emmanuel.jacob/).


<!-- Engagements -->
- Vice head of [IREM de Dijon](https://irem.ube.fr)

- Member of the project [CONDORCET](https://www.maths-vives.fr/projet/condorcet/), financed by PEPR Maths-VivES

- Member of [PEPR SolsVivants](https://pepr-solsvivants.fr)


<!-- Thèmes de recherche -->

<h3> Research interests </h3>
I am interested in :

- the study of random graphs with different aspects: the development of models and 
their application in ecology, the study of local limit in a dynamical setting, 
and the study of precesses evolving on these dynamical graphs (such as contact
process) ;
- the study of statistical depth functions and their application in voting 
procedures.
